title: Global Partners Pours On the Thanks for Teachers This September with a Month of Free Coffee
summary: From September 1 through 30, school employees can grab a free hot or iced coffee every single day, plus a chance to win a visit from the Coffee Trailer
body_markdown:
***From September 1 through 30, school employees can grab a free hot or iced coffee every single day, plus a chance to win a visit from the Coffee Trailer***


**Newton, Mass. (September 1, 2026) –** Class is back in session, and Global Partners, a leading independent liquid supplier and retail operator, is celebrating the educators, faculty and school staff who make it happen. Starting September 1 and running through September 30, 2026, guests with valid school identification showing current employment can enjoy one free hot or iced coffee, any size, once per day, at participating Global Partners retail locations.


“We know how hard teachers and school staff work, and this is our way of saying thank you,” said Jac Moskalik, Vice President, Head of Food, Innovation and Strategy at Global Partners. “Every school employee who shows their school ID can get one free coffee every day in September in any size that fits their morning.”


The free coffee offer is available across a wide family of Global Partners brands, including Alltown Fresh®, Alltown, JiffyMart, T-Bird, Wheels, Mr. Mike’s, Xtramart®, Millers, Honey Farms™, Honey Farms Market™ and Honey Farms Texas. All a school employee needs to do is show their ID to a store associate and enjoy a well-deserved cup on the house.


But the celebration does not stop at the counter. Guests are invited to nominate their local school for a visit from the Coffee Trailer, a mobile treat that will make its way to ten lucky schools across Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York and Rhode Island. It is a fun, hands-on way for communities to rally around the schools that shape their neighborhoods.


At Alltown Fresh locations, the good feeling brews even stronger. Throughout September, Alltown Fresh will donate a portion of overall coffee sales to a local partner school in the same town as each store, supporting 18 schools in total. Every cup purchased helps fuel a classroom close to home.


“Our stores work to promote local good and fuel our communities,” Moskalik continued. “This campaign is a simple, joyful way to show educators just how much they mean to the neighborhoods we serve.”


Guests can learn more and get involved at[beeskneesbenefits.com/freecoffee](https://beeskneesbenefits.com/freecoffee/) . Alltown Fresh fans can also visit[alltownfresh.com/coffeeforeducators](https://alltownfresh.com/coffeeforeducators/) for brand-specific details as the campaign kicks off. You can also discover how Coffee for Educators is making an impact by watching this[video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=j8qRe9XA6y-zNvRX&v=Ekox58I3WgY&feature=youtu.be) .


So, help us raise a cup to the teachers who show up early, stay late and never stop giving their best. This September, Global Partners is proud to return the favor, one cup at a time.


**About Global Partners LP:**


*Building on a legacy that began more than 90 years ago, Global Partners has evolved into a Fortune 500 company and industry-leading integrated owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and guest-focused retail experiences. Global operates or maintains dedicated storage at 54 liquid energy terminals—with connectivity to strategic rail, pipeline, and marine assets—spanning from Maine to Florida and into the U.S. Gulf States. Through this extensive network, the company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, and renewable fuels to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers. In addition, Global has a large portfolio of owned, leased and/or supplied retail locations across the Northeast states, the Mid-Atlantic, and Texas, providing the fuels people need to keep them on the go at their unique guest-focused convenience destinations. Recognized as one of Fortune’s Most Admired Companies, Global Partners is embracing progress and diversifying to meet the needs of the energy transition.*
